annotation.title_clean: Guidance Note on Consumer Protection and the Responsible Adoption and Use of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning by Licensed Financial Institutions in the U.A.E.
annotation.title_en: Guidance Note on Consumer Protection and the Responsible Adoption and Use of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning by Licensed Financial Institutions in the U.A.E.
annotation.summary_en: Central Bank of the UAE guidance note setting flexible principles for licensed financial institutions using AI/ML, focused on consumer protection: governance, fairness, transparency, data quality, monitoring, human oversight, third-party risk and complaints. It contains no robotics or physical-system content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Board and senior management are accountable for AI systems; firms should not use AI models they cannot control.
Annual and change-triggered bias testing; no discriminatory or manipulative AI deployment.
Disclose AI use for high-impact decisions in Arabic and English; consider opt-out rights.
Meaningful human oversight (in/on/out-of-the-loop) proportionate to consumer risk; right to human review and complaints.
Third-party AI due diligence, AI model inventory, and ability to cease using AI immediately.
